description: This file defines utility functions, enums, and classes related to autograd variable handling in PyTorch, including in-place mutation checks, view creation, and autograd metadata management.

classes.name: WrapperFunctor
classes.description: Functor class wrapping JitDecompInterface for use as a c10::OperatorKernel.

classes.name: Flatten
classes.description: Helper class for flattening tensors into a variable list.

methods.name: can_mutate_inplace
methods.description: Checks if an in-place mutation is allowed on a tensor given its requires_grad status.

methods.name: check_inplace
methods.description: Performs checks before in-place operations to ensure correctness.

methods.name: throw_error_out_requires_grad
methods.description: Throws an error if a function with out=... arguments is called with a tensor requiring grad.

methods.name: throw_error_for_complex_autograd
methods.description: Throws an error if autograd is attempted on complex tensors.

methods.name: throw_error_if_base_and_tensor_are_same
methods.description: Throws an error if a view operation returns the same tensor as its base.

methods.name: rebase_history
methods.description: Rebases autograd history for a variable with a new grad_fn.

methods.name: increment_version
methods.description: Increments the version counter of a tensor.

methods.name: flatten_tensor_args
methods.description: Flattens multiple tensor arguments into a variable list.

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Creates a differentiable or non-differentiable view of a tensor, managing autograd metadata.

methods.name: check_no_requires_grad
methods.description: Checks that tensors do not require gradients, with optional grad mode check.

methods.name: make_saved_variable_list
methods.description: Creates a list of SavedVariable objects from tensor lists.

methods.name: to_args_sizes
methods.description: Returns sizes of tensors as vectors of int64_t.

methods.name: to_args_sizes_symint
methods.description: Returns sizes of tensors as vectors of c10::SymInt.
